sentences.text: No— for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
That applies here because the case is a floating, non_business loan to an individual sanctioned on 2026-01-01, and para 261 applies to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
The documents do not state a usual rate for this case because the applicable rule says no pre-payment charges are to be levied.

missing.searched: pre-payment penalty rate for floating-rate personal loans to individuals sanctioned in 2026
